caption: A close, slightly high-angle view shows a black gas stovetop with four cast-iron grates set on speckled granite. A gloved hand already holds a steam nozzle that emits a white vapor jet onto the right-side burners. The nozzle sweeps across the right front and rear grate areas and the back edge of the cooktop. As the steam is emitted, the plume expands and drifts leftward over the center, partially veiling the burners beneath it. The surface appears dark and wet from the continuous spray. The framing gradually widens toward the right, bringing a pale-green steam unit with a black hose into view resting on the counter. The grates remain seated in place, and the spraying continues without pause.
relations: A gloved hand holding a steam nozzle emits a white vapor jet onto the right-side burners.
The nozzle sweeps across the right grates, causing the plume to expand and drift leftward over the center.
Continuous spraying darkens and wets the stovetop surface while the grates remain seated in place.
The framing widens toward the right, revealing a pale-green steam unit with a black hose resting on the counter.
